title.zh: Bitget confirms $351M security breach, suspends withdrawals
title.en: Bitget confirms $351M security breach, suspends withdrawals

current_state.zh: Bitget confirmed roughly $351.6 million in unauthorized transfers from a limited number of hot and warm wallets and temporarily suspended withdrawals while investigating the breach, saying cold wallets and user balances were unaffected.
current_state.en: Bitget confirmed roughly $351.6 million in unauthorized transfers from a limited number of hot and warm wallets and temporarily suspended withdrawals while investigating the breach, saying cold wallets and user balances were unaffected.
